clusters.headline: Pakistani astronaut set to make history on Chinese space mission
aiSummaryBullets: Al Jazeera reports: Pakistani astronaut set to make history on Chinese space mission
Deutsche Welle reports: Pakistani astronaut to join Chinese space mission

clusters.headline: Former Pakistan Prime Minister Requests Urgent Medical Assistance
aiSummaryBullets: Imran Khan has appealed to the Pakistani judiciary for immediate health assessments for himself and his wife.
The former Prime Minister reported that he is held in solitary confinement for 22 hours per day.

clusters.headline: Pakistani National Sentenced For Role In Plot Targeting Politicians
aiSummaryBullets: Asif Merchant received a prison sentence exceeding 27 years for his participation in a conspiracy to assassinate US political figures.
The Department of Justice stated the defendant allegedly maintained ties to the Iranian government.

clusters.headline: Casualties Reported In Pakistan Following Security Incidents
aiSummaryBullets: A suicide car bombing at a security checkpoint resulted in five deaths and thirteen injuries.
The Pakistani military stated that its personnel eliminated 74 individuals identified as terrorists during recent raids.

clusters.headline: Two Arrested In India Over Rajasthan Railway Track Explosion Case
aiSummaryBullets: Two individuals were taken into custody in Gurdaspur, Punjab, following a November 3 railway track explosion in Rajasthan.
The Rajasthan Anti-Terrorism Squad reported that the suspects allegedly acted under instructions from handlers based in Pakistan.

clusters.headline: Pakistani National Sentenced To Prison For Targeting Donald Trump
aiSummaryBullets: A Pakistani national was sentenced to 27 years in prison for his role in planning an assassination attempt.
Reports indicate the planned attack was motivated by retribution for the 2020 killing of IRGC commander Qassem Soleimani.

clusters.headline: Pakistan Cricket Board Updates Central Contracts For Key Players
aiSummaryBullets: The Pakistan Cricket Board has implemented a new, format-based system for national player contracts.
Former team captains Mohammad Rizwan and Shan Masood have been excluded from the latest list of central contracts.
